title: Queen Liliuokalani
summary: Queen Liliʻuokalani was the last reigning monarch of the Hawaiian Kingdom, succeeding her brother King Kalākaua in 1891. When she sought to promulgate a new constitution restoring voting rights and monarchical authority, American and European sugar planters backed by armed US forces deposed her on 17 January 1893. She yielded her authority under protest to avoid bloodshed and fought peacefully for Hawaiian sovereignty until her death in 1917.
